name: 90006 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90006 (Los Angeles) has 292 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90006 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90006 (Los Angeles) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
